title: T-shirts — Lock-up for sub-programs, clubs or teams
slide_intent: Show how to make the team name the first read on a competition shirt while keeping its program affiliation visible.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can give teams room for a local motif or type style while the accredited program name and symbol consistently establish affiliation.
demonstration: An annotated lockup separates the local name and animal motif above from the program name and symbol below. Four shirt fronts vary the identity of the team.
practical_value: Set the local team name prominently, place the accredited program name beneath in uppercase Ubuntu Bold and center the symbol below it.

content_islands.name: Team-name rules
content_islands.spec: Place four numbered notes beside the lockup and examples. Identify the local choices and the standardized affiliation.

content_islands.name: Lockup anatomy
content_islands.spec: Use dashed guides and labels to separate the animal and name from the program type and symbol. Pair the drawing with a yellow shirt application.

content_islands.name: Team variations
content_islands.spec: Compare shirts with a local name, area number and place names across several colors. Keep the program identifier in a consistent supporting position.
